purpose: Photoreal source portraits for PARALLAX project planet rendering, matching the approved GATTO v207 realism direction.
processing: Generated PNGs copied byte-for-byte, with original transparency preserved. Planet volume, lighting and orbits are handled by the shared production renderer.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ultra-realistic production portrait texture for a dimensional floating character planet in PARALLAX. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND QUALITY reference only: keep its photographic microdetail, tasteful cinematic lighting, crisp transparent silhouette; DO NOT reproduce the black cat or golden rim as the subject. The new subject must look physically real, like premium animal photography, not a cartoon mascot, toy, clay, emoji, plush or plastic. Square image with genuine transparent alpha background, single centered frontal symmetrical subject looking directly at viewer. About 84% of canvas occupied; leave clear margin around all ears/hat/whiskers; do not crop extremities. Soft upper-left studio key, gentle right fill, restrained rim; natural shadows, rich but realistic colors. No background, no starfield, no text, no logos, no watermark, no orbital rings, no moon, no pedestal, no floating decorative objects.
Subject: a compact round-headed red-orange Shiba Inu dog inspired by BONK, head only with no neck or body. Realistic fine orange guard hairs, pale cream muzzle and cheeks, small cream eyebrow patches, upright triangular ears with soft peach inner fur, calm slightly sleepy brown almond eyes with small natural catchlights, moist black nose, relaxed closed mouth with subtle knowing expression. Rounded generous cheeks but anatomically convincing proportions; individual fur and whiskers visibly detailed. Preserve orange-and-cream dog identity.

reference_images.role: Edit target: first PENGU realism portrait; composition and palette preserved

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached isolated PENGU character source image. Make ONE targeted realism correction while preserving its identity, exact square framing, centered frontal pose, complete compact rounded silhouette, soft upper-left lighting, the periwinkle/slate-blue crown/back/flippers, broad white facial mask and white belly, peach-orange bill and feet, and the genuine transparent background.
Replace the current plush-toy appearance with a convincingly real juvenile penguin photographed with a wildlife portrait lens. Make its eyes considerably smaller and naturally recessed within feathered eyelids, anatomically plausible dark bird eyes with only tiny subtle catchlights, no enormous glossy glass buttons. Replace uniform hair-like fuzz across the face and belly with very short dense layered penguin feathers and fine juvenile down: close feather grains, overlapping directional feather rows over blue crown and flippers, gently mottled compact down on the belly, natural imperfect microdetail. Make the little bill anatomically plausible and slightly slimmer, hard keratin with an understated natural seam, without exaggerated cartoon nostrils. Keep the two short flippers close at the sides and webbed feet, with believable avian anatomy. Keep the existing body proportions and placement close enough for the same source-texture mapping.
This is a REAL animal interpretation of the established character, not a plush toy, doll, cartoon, mascot suit or Pixar render. Retain the blue/white/orange brand palette but with realistic restrained saturation. No rings, no environment, no ground shadow, no text, no accessories, no border. Preserve true transparent alpha and the entire uncut silhouette.
assets.revision_reason: Reduced oversized glossy eyes and replaced plush-like fur with short layered feathering/down for more convincing juvenile penguin realism.

reference_images.role: Existing project identity and component reference
